'''Quarren City''' was a major population center for the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] people of the [[Water/Legends|water]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]].<ref name="WaterWar" />

==History==
Located in the [[Alopia Rift]], Quarren City consisted of a series of disc-shaped structures along the ocean floor around volcanic vents. Illuminated by green lights, the dark city supported the mining operations of [[Quarren Industrial]], and housed their [[Quarren Industrial Headquarters|Headquarters]].<ref name="SoR" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Quarren City was the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Quarren headquarters/Legends|staging ground]] prior to the second [[Battle of Mon Cala/Legends|battle]]. [[Riff Tamson]] led the attack on [[Coral City/Legends|Coral City]] from the headquarters here.<ref name="WaterWar" />
